adds.title: Thor: The Dark World
adds.text: Jane is hurt that Thor stayed away for two years, but when the Aether enters her body he takes her to Asgard to save her. Together they stop Malekith in Greenwich.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Jane's love, who takes her to Asgard when the Aether enters her.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Thor's love, whom he takes to Asgard to save her from the Aether.
adds.evidence: Thor finds Foster after the Aether enters her and takes her to Asgard; they reunite in London and Jane's group helps Thor defeat Malekith at the Greenwich Convergence; post-credits they reunite on Earth.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.: Slingshot#3
adds.text: Fitz and Simmons, now a couple, work side by side in the lab, upgrading Yo-Yo's watch and running her Inhuman registration.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Jemma's boyfriend and lab partner, who runs Yo-Yo's registration with her.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Fitz's girlfriend and lab partner, who runs Yo-Yo's registration with him.
adds.evidence: Slingshot episode 3: at the lab Fitz and Simmons upgrade Yo-Yo's watch and do her physical assessment and Inhuman registration together while she secretly runs a search. Minor shared scene; added so the tie shows for a viewer of the web series.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.#123
adds.text: When Chronicom hunters overrun the Lighthouse, Fitz and Jemma rig a room with bombs and plan to die together to stop them. Then they accept Enoch's plan to save Earth, knowing it will change their lives forever.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Jemma's love, ready to die beside her until Enoch offers another way.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Fitz's love, ready to die beside him until Enoch offers another way.
adds.evidence: #123 is S6#13 'New Life': Fitz and Simmons rig the Toolbox room with bombs to sacrifice themselves, then Enoch offers a plan that 'will change Fitz's and Simmons' lives forever'. Note: the S6 reunion itself (Fitz captured by Malachi and reunited with Simmons on the Confederacy ship, mid-S6) has no stage; see owner call.

adds.title: Jessica Jones S3#13
adds.text: Luke waits for Jessica at her door and tells her that, as much as it hurt, he sent his own brother away. He trusts her to do what she has to do to stop Trish.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Jessica's ex, who urges her to stop Trish as he stopped his own brother.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Luke's ex, whom he trusts to stop her sister Trish.
adds.evidence: 'AKA Everything' (S3E13): Jones finds Luke Cage waiting by her door; he tells her he sent his brother Willis Stryker to the Raft because it was right, hopes she will do the same with Walker, and says he trusts her to do what she has to.

adds.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
adds.text: Maggie and Paxton, still raising Cassie together, pick her up from Scott's house arrest. When the FBI barges in, Maggie calls it harassment and Paxton tells her the agents are only doing their job.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Paxton's partner, who calls the FBI's visits to Scott harassment.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Maggie's partner, a cop who tells her the FBI is only doing its job.
adds.evidence: Paxton and Maggie go to Scott's house together to pick up Cassie, video call him together, return for her soccer shoes when the FBI bursts in (Maggie calls it harassment, Paxton says it isn't), watch Giant-Man on the news together at home, and hug Scott together when his sentence ends. (Fandom says they are married by then, citing a Blu-ray interview, so the text avoids 'married'.)

adds.title: The Marvels
adds.text: Muneeba fights off Kree attackers in the family home, then lets Kamala go into space with Carol and Monica. She tells her daughter she is chosen for a greater purpose, but that she will never let her go.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Kamala's mother, who lets her go into space but never lets her go.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Muneeba's daughter, whom she lets go into space with Carol and Monica.
adds.evidence: Muneeba hits a Kree with a vase during the attack on the Khan home; at S.A.B.E.R. she and Yusuf let Kamala go ('You are chosen for a greater purpose... of course you must go now. But I will never let you go'); she hugs Kamala when she returns and helps Carol move in the epilogue.

adds.title: The Marvels
adds.text: Yusuf asks Kamala whether Captain Marvel is pressuring her, and though he worries, he lets her go into space to stop Dar-Benn.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Kamala's father, who worries but lets her go into space.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Yusuf's daughter, whom he lets go into space to stop Dar-Benn.
adds.evidence: Yusuf: 'Is Captain Marvel pressuring you in any way?... you don't have to do as she says.' At S.A.B.E.R. Yusuf and Muneeba voice their worry, then let Kamala go; the family hugs her when she returns.

adds.title: The Defenders#1
adds.text: Karen, now a reporter, meets Matt for coffee. They talk about what his life as Daredevil meant to him, and she congratulates him on winning his latest case.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Karen's old love, who has put Daredevil behind him.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Matt's old love, now a reporter he meets for coffee.
adds.evidence: 'The H Word' (Defenders E1): Murdock and Page agree to lunch, then have coffee; he mentions her school board story, they discuss him revealing he is Daredevil and what that life is to him, and she congratulates him on the Aaron James case. Later episodes: E5 he tells her he is Daredevil again and takes her to hide at the precinct; E7 she warns him his identity could be exposed; E8 she grieves when he does not return from Midland Circle (see owner call).

adds.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
adds.text: Maggie tells Scott how proud she is of how much he has changed during his house arrest. When it ends, she and her family greet him at her door with a group hug.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Maggie's ex-husband, whose change makes her proud.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Scott's ex-wife, proud of how much he has changed.
adds.evidence: Maggie picks Cassie up from Scott's house, tells him the next time she sees him he'll be off house arrest, and comments on how much he has changed for the better; she video calls him about Cassie's shoes; when he is released she opens her door and the family runs out to hug him.

adds.title: The Defenders#5
adds.text: With the Hand loose in the city, Trish and Malcolm shelter at the precinct with the Defenders' other loved ones, trading gossip about Karen and Foggy.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Jessica's sister, who waits out the Hand's threat with Malcolm.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Jessica's friend, who waits out the Hand's threat with Trish.
adds.evidence: 'Take Shelter' (Defenders E5): at the precinct, Walker and Malcolm Ducasse gossip about Page and Nelson; in E8 they walk in together with news of Midland Circle and greet Jessica on her return. Minor shared scene.

owner_calls.question: The proposed Defenders stage sits at #1 (coffee). Should there also be a stage at The Defenders#8, where Karen grieves when Matt does not come back from Midland Circle? (S3#6 already says she refuses to believe he died.)
owner_calls.evidence: Defenders E5: he tells her he is Daredevil again and takes her to hide; E8: Page and Nelson wait for him at the precinct, realize he is gone and grieve at Clinton Church.

owner_calls.question: Season 6 has no stage before the proposed #123: Fitz, captured by Malachi, is reunited with Simmons on the Confederacy ship, they are plugged into the Cerebral Fusion Machine, then fly home together. Add a reunion stage mid-S6 (outside this batch's titles)?
owner_calls.evidence: Leo Fitz biography: captured by Malachi and brought to a Confederacy ship, 'reuniting' with Simmons, both plugged into the Cerebral Fusion Machine, then escape and head for Earth on the Lazy Comet.
